question: What is the primary focus of Primary Health Care within a community?

options.A: Providing basic, accessible health services close to where people live
options.B: Building advanced surgical centers in every rural village
options.C: Managing tertiary care hospitals in capital cities
options.D: Focusing exclusively on treating rare chronic diseases

explanation: Primary health care aims to bring essential health services as close as possible to the community members who need them. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T2#GNS124_U1_T2_h1)

question: Why is primary health care considered the bedrock of a solid health system?

options.A: It focuses solely on emergency trauma surgeries
options.B: It is funded entirely by international donors rather than local governments
options.C: It eliminates the need for any specialized doctors or hospitals
options.D: It prevents minor health issues from becoming major hospital burdens by catching them early

explanation: By offering promotive and preventive services early at the community level, PHC stops health problems from escalating. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T2#GNS124_U1_T2_h1)

question: What was the main characteristic of the health care model before the Alma-Ata conference?

options.A: It relied entirely on traditional herbal practitioners in rural areas
options.B: It focused primarily on community-based disease prevention
options.C: It was heavily curative and concentrated in urban hospitals
options.D: It provided free universal insurance for all citizens equally

explanation: Before Alma-Ata, global health systems focused on treating sick patients in city-based hospitals rather than preventing disease in communities. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T2#GNS124_U1_T2_h2)

question: How did the pre-Alma-Ata medical model contribute to severe health disparities?

options.A: By placing too much emphasis on handwashing and clean water over medicine
options.B: By locking resources and trained staff in cities while rural populations were left neglected
options.C: By forcing doctors to travel constantly to remote villages instead of staying in labs
options.D: By making prescription drugs too cheap for pharmaceutical companies to survive

explanation: Concentrating medical resources in urban centers meant poor and rural populations had little to no access to basic healthcare. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T2#GNS124_U1_T2_h2)

question: What famous global health goal was established at the 1978 Alma-Ata conference?

options.C: Health for All by the Year 2000
options.D: Free Tertiary Care for Every Citizen

explanation: The Alma-Ata conference set the ambitious global target of achieving 'Health for All by the Year 2000' through primary health care. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T2#GNS124_U1_T2_h3)

question: Why did the Alma-Ata Declaration emphasize intersectoral collaboration for health?

options.A: Because doctors need help from corporate business owners to run pharmacies
options.B: Because factors like housing, education, and agriculture directly influence community health
options.C: Because hospital administrators wanted to share their paperwork with local schools
options.D: Because nurses must learn how to farm to provide proper nutrition advice

explanation: Health is shaped by social and environmental factors outside the clinic, requiring teamwork across different societal sectors. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T2#GNS124_U1_T2_h3)

question: What is the name of the special agency established in 1987 to drive primary health care in Nigeria?

options.B: West African Nursing and Midwifery Council
options.C: Federal Ministry of Tertiary Education and Health
options.D: National Primary Health Care Development Agency

explanation: Nigeria established the NPHCDA in 1987 to coordinate and strengthen primary health care delivery across the country. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T2#GNS124_U1_T2_h4)

question: A community health nurse working in a rural Nigerian primary health care clinic is struggling to store vaccines properly due to frequent power outages. Which underlying systemic issue does this practical challenge highlight?

options.A: The total failure of the community participation principle
options.B: An overabundance of highly trained specialist surgeons in the village
options.C: Infrastructure deficits like erratic electricity affecting basic service delivery
options.D: A lack of willingness from mothers to immunize their babies

explanation: Logistical challenges such as power failures and supply chain gaps remain real hurdles in many Nigerian primary health centers. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T2#GNS124_U1_T2_h4)

question: What was the main focus of 'Selective Primary Health Care' introduced after the initial Alma-Ata momentum slowed?

options.A: Targeting specific, high-impact interventions for particular diseases
options.B: Stopping all vaccination programs to focus entirely on surgery
options.C: Handing over all health clinics to private international corporations
options.D: Building large multi-specialty teaching hospitals in every district

explanation: Selective PHC concentrated resources on specific, measurable disease interventions rather than broad, comprehensive health system building. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T2#GNS124_U1_T2_h5)

question: How do the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) differ from the earlier selective health approaches?

options.A: They rely only on private hospitals instead of community clinics
options.B: They focus exclusively on curing adult heart disease in wealthy nations
options.C: They completely ignore maternal and child health in favor of space research
options.D: They return to a broader, more comprehensive vision of health linked to overall development

explanation: SDG 3 and related goals embrace a wide-ranging view of health and well-being, echoing the holistic spirit of the original Alma-Ata declaration. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T2#GNS124_U1_T2_h5)

question: Where and when was the global declaration reaffirming primary health care signed to mark the 40th anniversary of Alma-Ata?
explanation: The Astana Declaration was adopted in Kazakhstan in 2018 to revitalize global commitment to primary health care. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T2#GNS124_U1_T2_h6)

question: Which of the following is NOT a core pillar emphasized in the Astana Declaration for modern PHC?

options.A: Building exclusive luxury medical resorts for international medical tourists
options.B: Working across multiple sectors like education and environment
options.C: Empowering individuals and communities to take charge of their health
options.D: Securing strong political commitment and sustained public investment

explanation: Luxury medical tourism for the elite is not part of the Astana pillars, which focus on grassroots universal health coverage for all. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T2#GNS124_U1_T2_h6)

question: Why is the rise of non-communicable diseases changing the daily work of primary health care nurses?

options.A: It completely eliminates the need for basic medications in rural clinics
options.B: It means nurses no longer need to worry about immunizing infants against infections
options.C: It allows nurses to stop providing care and refer every patient immediately abroad
options.D: It requires long-term patient education, lifestyle coaching, and chronic disease monitoring

explanation: Chronic conditions like diabetes and hypertension demand ongoing support, lifestyle guidance, and continuous follow-up from nurses. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T2#GNS124_U1_T2_h7)

question: A community health nurse notices many young people in her village developing untreated high blood pressure. What action best reflects modern primary health care nursing practice?

options.A: Waiting inside the urban teaching hospital for patients to travel and find her
options.B: Focusing solely on childhood immunizations and ignoring adult health entirely
options.C: Organizing a local screening camp combined with lifestyle and diet counseling
options.D: Telling the villagers that chronic illnesses cannot be managed at the local level

explanation: Proactive community screening and health education bring prevention and early management directly to the people, fulfilling PHC goals. [learn more](GNS124_U1_T2#GNS124_U1_T2_h7)
